content: 5:1-5 Munon yamangar qarig iroau qomon eng Korin end igoai

Yamangar song-song ubumot abau qomon eng an end irou ebet igamari qob toau isa igub igoum. Qomon eng munon Yisas yurau ue eng me ebet igour eng an aninou wes ar abari igoum. Eng ete: Munon ger wonou ur ubeni eng baurei.
An qob sig me igoumon ne? Qomon eng bais wogub aninomi toubet gaiar. Munon ger qomon ende aba gab eng an qarausiari aninob me igorinerei.

Ye yonomit qemeribam eng. Ye git eng mugenderi e igoum. Ego yonou igom meriri eng anamar igo. Ininou Munon Barai Yisas wo unum end ye aninob igamau gas ende igo munon qomon boru ebeter eng ye qo qereimetet ugamei.
Aninou erogori igoumon. Ye eng ininou Munon Barai Yisas yeseara yonou igom meriri eng anamar igo.
Munon qomon boru ebeter eng Satant duimari isa wonou git goan eng ba sumungasieriner. Ende aba ne wonou igom meriri eng igama Munon Aib qen sindomund gab deriner end musieriner.
5:6-13 Korin wuri munon ger qomon biisita gab eng agi wogunor
An qob igub bo me igau gas ebet igoumon eng boru. Yis baiste ba wit wambin si wogub baab isiari aib qarib igo eng an qoyam ue e?

An yis nai boru eng biruet arirmari mani parau bubun eng gari wagari igoriner. In qen aib Pasova eng gab mani yis ue nub igoun eng qo arsitarerei. Qen aib end wai sipsip wan waramb igour eng uput qamb Munon inubersiau tari nam tenori big waramir eng.

In wonou qen qau end igub mani nub qamb eng yis nai end misir me igun. Yis nai eng qomon boru sig qau. Mani parau yis nob ue tor eng nub ne qen aib eng gun. Mani parau bubun eng misir uber qomon bubun eng.
Ye qob ger qamb gumatarem eng ete qamb gumatemei: An munon yamangar song-song ubumot qib igour eng nob sori me igoarar.

Ye qob eng at qamam eng. Munon gugum yamangar ubumot qiyo, a munon ger wonomi gab qenunget wot ba qiyo, a mi urim ba qomon biisitet qiyo, ai bigau, sogoin qamb song-song wurit oabig igour eng gagar gugum wurisiningoar wagar qamb me qamarau. An ende at eng ai e gor mom woguboumon.
Ye qob gumatem eng ete: Munon ger aninou bain qamb igorunon eng qomon boru eng gagar quraum eng ebetrima gab eng gari bo qarausi ne mi nob me niar.
Maigas, munon Yisas me imbig igour eng wurinou qomon qereimau eng ye sarau ue, Qenu wonou wuriqereimba. Munon aninou erogori Yisas imbig igoumon eng an wuriqerei igoumon.
Qenu qob ete qura: “Munon qomon boru ebet an nob sori igo eng boopur wes arirmari igoriner,” ende qamara igoun.
